# Demo Refund Policy

> **Draft for review — not an approved policy.** This summary is based on
> `data/policies/Policies.pdf`, pages 1–2. The PDF labels itself a controlled
> draft and says to verify approval status before use. Do not rely on or publish
> this as current customer guidance until an authorized reviewer approves it.

## Return window

The source says most items in new condition may be returned within 30 days of
receipt. Product exclusions and condition requirements below also apply.

## Condition and item requirements

- **Apparel:** New, unworn, undamaged, with original tags attached.
- **Shoes, bags, and luggage:** New, unworn, undamaged, with original tags,
  branded boxes, and all accessories.
- **Electronics:** Original sealed and non-activated condition. Remove personal
  information and include the original packaging, manuals, accessories, and any
  supplied free gifts. The source says a refund cannot be provided if parts are
  missing or the item is unsellable. For a manufacturer's warranty claim,
  support can help contact the manufacturer.
- **Listed apparel exclusions:** Bodysuits, lingerie, jewelry, underwear, and
  other accessories, except scarves and bags.
- **Cosmetics:** Not returnable if damaged or if the seal has been broken.
- **Free gifts:** Return eligibility depends on their status at the time of
  payment.
- **Customized items:** Order cancellation is not supported.
- **Marked items:** Items with a sticker stating they are non-returnable are
  excluded.

## Starting a return

The source instructs customers to sign in to their Customer Support account,
open the Customer Support icon, start a chat with the agent, and ask about
Returns and Refunds to be guided through the procedure.

Items from different orders may be returned together if each item meets the
stated conditions. The source says to put all items being returned in one
package.

## Refund method and timing

- The refund is sent to the Kgomo Mart wallet or the original payment method,
  according to the refund method selected.
- If no method was selected, the source says to follow the choice in the refund
  record.
- Purchases paid for with gift cards are returned as gift cards.
- After a refund is processed, a notification is sent by email or SMS. The
  time for the funds to arrive depends on the refund method and bank; the source
  gives no specific timeline.
- For security, a card refund goes only to the original card. If that card has
  expired, is locked, or is no longer valid, the source instructs the customer
  to contact the card issuer or bank.

## Information not specified

The source does not specify return shipping fees, collection fees, processing
fees, or delivery estimates. These must come from a current approved policy or
the order/fulfilment system; do not guess or guarantee them.
